newsitem.title: EGYPT: Central Egypt Mills year-end profits up.
newsitem.headline: Central Egypt Mills year-end profits up.

text.p: Central Egypt Flour Mills said on Tuesday it made net after-tax profits of 41.842 million pounds ($12.3 million) in the financial year 1995/6, 68 percent up on 24.887 million in the previous year.
Audited results made available to brokers in September said net after-tax profits were 33.5 million pounds but brokers said on Tuesday these must have been for the first nine months.

Central Egypt Flour Mills said 1995/6 profits for distribution to shareholders were 28.701 million pounds, equivalent to 3.07 pounds for each of the 9.35 million shares in the company. That compares with 15.472 million in 1994/5.
At the end of the year, shareholders' funds were worth 105.411 million pounds, the company said.
The shares were trading at about 44.00 pounds on the Egyptian stock exchange at 1100 GMT on Tuesday, up from a close of 41.00 on Monday.
In April the state privatised about 2.8 million of the shares, or 30 percent of the equity, at 18.00 pounds each.
